summary: T08 conflict-safe update is correct: matching If-Match routes through EventService and rotates ETag; stale/missing precondition returns 412 without mutation via two-layer ETag+version conflict detection; unauthorized updates fail with 404 without disclosure. All 5 T08 tests plus full CalDAV and lib suites pass; cargo check and clippy clean.
important_context: ETag is a strong tag derived from SHA-256 of canonical iCalendar content including SEQUENCE (event version), so it rotates on every update
Two-layer conflict detection: ETag precondition check (412) + atomic version check in EventService.update (412 on conflict)

The put_update_unauthorized test exercises the cross-user principal check; the role-based denial path (viewer role) is covered by the shared authorize_calendar_action logic also tested in put_viewer_role_is_404 for create
